svg.text: Coin (harmonics 1–35, Fejér weights, amplitude per harmonic R/72, center 90°)
Cup (harmonics 1–23, Fejér weights, amplitude per harmonic R/36, center 60°)
Waveform: f(ψ) = a R Σm=1…N (1 − m/(N+1)) cos m(ψ − θ); Drawn as: distance from the center r(ψ) = R + f(ψ)
Coin: N = 35, a = 1/72, θ = 90°, peak height 0.243 R; Cup: N = 23, a = 1/36, θ = 60°, peak height 0.319 R
